execution_context.file_location: Injected JavaScript in Magento e-commerce CMS pages

malicious_snippets.code_snippet: Malicious JavaScript injected into e-commerce checkout pages to steal payment information (exact code not provided in report).
malicious_snippets.code_behavior: At runtime, the code captures payment form data entered by users and sends it to an attacker-controlled server, enabling credit card data exfiltration.

malice_analysis.why_suspicious: Capturing sensitive payment information from users and exfiltrating it to an external server is a classic sign of Magecart-style skimming attacks.
malice_analysis.violated_expectations: Legitimate e-commerce JavaScript should not exfiltrate payment data to unknown domains.
malice_analysis.similar_legitimate_use: Legitimate payment processors may collect payment data, but only to trusted, PCI-compliant endpoints.
key_indicators: JavaScript code capturing form fields related to payment
Network requests to untrusted or attacker-controlled domains

attack_chain.action: Attacker injects malicious JavaScript into Magento e-commerce websites.
attack_chain.leads_to: Execution of code in users' browsers during checkout

attack_chain.action: Malicious JavaScript captures payment information entered by users.
attack_chain.leads_to: Exfiltration of payment data to attacker

attack_chain.action: Stolen payment data is sent to attacker-controlled infrastructure.
attack_chain.leads_to: Attacker receives and can monetize stolen credit card data

behavioral_signatures: JavaScript code capturing payment form fields
Unexpected network requests from checkout pages to external domains
file_indicators: Injected or obfuscated JavaScript in Magento CMS templates
Unexpected script tags or inline event handlers in checkout pages
network_indicators: Outbound HTTP/HTTPS requests from checkout pages to non-payment domains
Connections to known Magecart or skimmer infrastructure
detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: Monitor e-commerce checkout pages for unauthorized or obfuscated JavaScript, especially code that accesses payment form fields and sends data to external domains. Use web application firewalls and content security policies to block suspicious script injections and outbound data exfiltration.
